p0.en: Summary of this chapter: Motives and Emotions

p1.en: The subject of reflection in this chapter

p2.original: 动机与情绪理论如何帮助我们了解复杂的人类，如马库斯·马里奥塔、我们的家人和朋友……也许，甚至我们自己？
p2.en: How can motivation and emotional theory help us understand complex human beings, such as Marcus Mariota, our families and friends... perhaps, even ourselves?

p3.original: 动机的主观性促使心理学家使用各种方法间接地研究其内在机制，包括动物研究、主题统觉测验（TAT）和大脑扫描。
p3.en: The subjectivity of motivations prompts psychologists to indirectly study their inner mechanisms using various methods, including animal research, subject epidemiology tests (TT) and brain scanning.

p4.original: 心理学家已经确定了许多对动机产生重要影响的因素，包括文化、目标、无意识过程、各种生理因素和社会压力。奖励（无论是内在的还是外在的）对于像马库斯·马里奥塔这样的世界级运动员来说也是很重要的。
p4.en: Psychologists have identified a number of factors that have a significant impact on motivation, including culture, objectives, unconscious processes, various biological factors and social pressures. Incentives (both intrinsic and external) are also important for world-class athletes like Marcus Mariota.

p5.original: 最大的问题之一是我们对动机的优先级排序，马斯洛在其著名的需要层次理论中解决了这个问题。最近，进化心理学家提出了一种新的需要层次理论。许多运动员、演员和艺术家显然是在一种心流状态下完成他们的大部分工作的，即一种精神状态，在这种精神状态下，人们专注于内在的奖励任务，排除了所有其他需要。
p5.en: One of the biggest problems is our prioritization of motivation, which Maslow has addressed in his famous hierarchy of needs. Recently, a new theory of the level of need was introduced by an evolutionary psychologist. It is clear that many athletes, actors and artists do most of their work in a state of heart flow, that is, a state of mind, in which people focus on intrinsic reward tasks, excluding all other needs.

p6.original: 理解动机还需要理解一个人的情绪，因为情绪是由外部世界中的人、物和环境引起的一类动机。当我们做出选择和决定时，情绪能帮助我们评估各个选项的“价值”。
p6.en: Understanding motivation also requires understanding one's emotions, which are a sort of motivation caused by people, goods and the environment in the outside world. When we make choices and decisions, emotions can help us assess the “value” of each option.

p9.original: 动机是行为表现的内在倾向，容易受到内部和外部因素的影响。
p9.en: Motivated by an inherent tendency to behave, they are vulnerable to internal and external factors.

p10.original: 动机的概念是指选择和指引行为朝向一个目标的内在推断过程。动机也有助于理解那些不能单独用环境解释的行为。心理学家发现了区分内在动机和外在动机的必要性。
p10.en: The concept of motivation refers to an intrinsic inference process that selects and directs conduct towards a goal. Motivation also helps to understand those acts that cannot be interpreted in isolation from the environment. Psychologists have identified the need to distinguish between underlying and external motivations.

p11.original: 人们为什么要工作？奖励理论认为，他们这样做是为了获得回报，但更复杂的期望理论增加了对成功的合理预期。大卫·麦克利兰的理论强调了成就需要，这是工业/组织心理学家关注员工动机和工作满意度的一个重要动机。对成就的需要也与学术成就和生活中的其他成就相关。但是，正如麦克利兰所说的，和成就需要一样重要的是对权力和归属的需要。跨文化研究还表明，不同社会对成就的需要强度不同，这取决于他们倾向于个体主义还是集体主义。
p11.en: Why do people work? Incentives theory suggests that they do so in return, but more complex expectation theory increases reasonable expectations of success. David McLeland's theory emphasizes the need for achievement, which is an important motivation for industry/organizational psychologists to focus on employee motivation and job satisfaction. The need for achievements is also linked to academic and other achievements in life. But, as McLean has said, as important as the need for achievement is the need for power and attribution. Cross-cultural research also shows that different societies have different levels of need for achievements, depending on whether they prefer individualism or collectivism.

p12.original: 心理学家发现，外部奖励会通过过度合理化破坏内在奖励任务的动机。然而，这种情况并不总是存在的，只有在不考虑工作表现而给予奖励时才会发生。
p12.en: Psychologists have found that external rewards undermine the underlying motivation for rewarding tasks through excessive rationalization. However, this is not always the case and only when incentives are given without regard to job performance.

p13.original: 巨大的成就通常来自处于心流状态的人。那些处于“心流”状态的人是受到了某些问题或活动的内在激励，而使用药物或酒精达到人工心流的感觉显然是无效的。
p13.en: Great achievements usually come from people in a state of mind. Those who are in “heart flow” are motivated by problems or activities that are intrinsically ineffective in the sense that drugs or alcohol are used to reach artificial heart flow.

p14.original: 我们的动机优先级是如何确定的
p14.en: How do we prioritize our motivations?

p16.original: 一些长期问题因一个结合了马斯洛需要层次理论与进化心理学的新理论的出现而得以解决，该理论认为功能、近因和发展因素决定了我们动机的优先级。
p16.en: Some of the long-standing problems have been solved by the emergence of a new theory combining the hierarchical theory of Maslow's need and evolutionary psychology, which considers that functional, proximate and developmental factors determine the priority of our motivation.

p17.original: 没有一个心理学理论可以成功地解释所有的人类动机。心理学家已经从本能理论、固定行为模式、驱力理论和体内平衡等方面解释了基于生理的动机。认知心理学家强调生理动机。弗洛伊德呼吁关注无意识动机，并教导我们所有的动机都源自无意识的性欲和攻击性欲望。然而，这些方法都不能成功地解释人类动机的全部范畴。
p17.en: There is no psychological theory that can successfully explain all human motives. Psychologists have explained biological motivations in terms of instinctal theory, fixed behaviour patterns, driving theory and internal balance. Cognitive psychologists emphasize biological motivation. Freud called for attention to be paid to unintentional motivations and taught us that all motivations stem from unconscious sexual and offensive desires. However, none of these methods has succeeded in explaining the full range of human motives.

p18.original: 马斯洛试图用他那具有影响力的需要层次理论解释人类动机出现的优先级顺序。然而，批评者指出了他的理论的许多例外。最近，进化心理学家对马斯洛的理论进行了修正，认为我们的“默认”动机优先级是可以改变的，这取决于发展因素和重要（近因）的刺激。
p18.en: Maslow tried to use his influential hierarchy of needs to explain the order of priority in which human motives emerged. Critics, however, pointed to many exceptions to his theory. Recently, the theory of Maslow was revised by the evolutionary psychologist to the effect that our “acceptance” motivation priorities can be changed, depending on development factors and important (proximate) incentives.

p19.original: 要想了解一个人的动机，最好从外部激励和威胁入手。此外，阿尔弗雷德·阿德勒教授教导我们，社会动机可以解释许多问题行为。社会心理学家将这些概念结合在情境的力量这个标题下。
p19.en: To understand a person's motivation, it is best to start with external incentives and threats. In addition, Professor Alfred Adler taught us that social motivations can explain many of the many issues of behaviour. Social psychologists combine these concepts under the heading force of the situation.

p20.original: 饥饿和性在动机层次中处于哪个位置
p20.en: Where hunger and sexuality are at the motivation level

p22.original: 尽管饥饿和性在许多方面迥然不同，却都源于进化，而且都是生理和社会需要结合的产物，但只有一种需要是个体生存所必需的。
p22.en: Although hunger and sexuality differ in many respects, they are both a product of evolution and a combination of physical and social needs, only one need is necessary for the survival of individuals.

p23.original: 饥饿既是一种生理驱力，也是一种心理动机，最好的理解方法是多系统方法。美国人会收到来自媒体的混合信息，既提倡瘦，又提倡高热量食物，这可能会导致肥胖、神经性厌食症和神经性贪食症等疾病。虽然社会因素和生理因素都相关，但这些问题本身还没有被完全理解。肥胖问题在美国已成为一种流行病，并正迅速地蔓延到世界各地。许多人试图控制他们的食欲和体重，尽管没有任何减肥方案对大多数人长期有效。
p23.en: Hunger is both a physical and psychological motivation, and the best way to understand is a multi-system approach. Americans receive mixed messages from the media that promote both thinness and high-calorie food, which can lead to diseases such as obesity, neuro anorexia and neurocorruptia. Although both social and biological factors are relevant, these issues are not fully understood in themselves. Obesity has become an epidemic in the United States and is spreading rapidly throughout the world. Many have tried to control their appetite and weight, although no diet programmes have been effective for the majority of the population in the long term.

p24.original: “意志力”在日常语言中是一个常见的术语，尽管心理学家避免使用它，因为它意味着一种独立的心智能力。他们更喜欢用“冲动控制”或“自我控制”，这些术语在涉及大脑机制和环境影响时更容易被解释。最近，研究人员发现，控制冲动会对认知造成损害，并反映在血糖水平上。
p24.en: The term “willpower” is a common term in everyday languages, although psychologists avoid using it because it implies an independent mental ability. They prefer to use “aggressive control” or “self-control”, terms that are easier to interpret when it comes to brain mechanisms and environmental impacts. Recently, researchers have found that control impulses can cause cognitive damage and are reflected in blood sugar levels.

p25.original: 与饥饿和体重控制不同，性冲动不是为了追求内稳态，尽管其主要受生理因素的影响，但学习也起着作用，尤其是在人类中。特别是自金赛的调查以来，有关性的科学研究在美国引起了巨大的争议，尽管研究调查显示，在过去的半个世纪里，美国人在性行为方面变得更加自由。马斯特斯和约翰逊率先在实验室内对性行为进行了广泛的研究，发现男性和女性的性反应周期是相似的。最近，佩普洛强调了男性和女性在性行为上的差异。那些坚持进化论观点的人认为，男性和女性在性行为上的差异源于男性在竞争冲突中的交配策略和女性在怀孕过程中大量的生理投资，两者都主张男性更倾向于滥交。
p25.en: Unlike hunger and weight control, sexual impulse is not about internal stability, but learning also plays a role, especially in humans, although it is largely influenced by biological factors. Especially since the Kinsey survey, sexual research has given rise to considerable controversy in the United States, although research has shown that Americans have become more free in their sexuality over the past half century. Masters and Johnson took the lead in conducting extensive research on sexual behaviour in laboratories and found that the sexual response cycles were similar for men and women. Recently, Peplo highlighted the differences between men and women in sexual behaviour. Those who adhere to the evolutionary view believe that the difference between men and women in sexual behaviour stems from the man's mating strategy in the competition and the woman's significant biological investment in pregnancy, both of which favour greater male preference for promiscuity.

p26.original: 就像马斯洛的理论那样，新的基于进化的层次理论通常会将饥饿需要优先于性的需要，尽管这种层次等级也不固定。
p26.en: As in Maslow's theory, the new evolutionary hierarchy usually gives priority to hunger over sexual needs, even though the hierarchy is not fixed.

p27.original: 关于性的最大谜团是性取向的起源，特别是导致异性恋、同性恋和双性恋的因素。大多数专家认为，性取向涉及生理、环境和社会因素的综合，尽管很多研究都集中在生理研究上。自20世纪70年代以来，同性恋就不再被心理学家和精神病学家视为一种疾病了。
p27.en: The greatest mystery about sexuality is the origin of sexual orientation, in particular the factors that lead to heterosexual, homosexual and bisexuality. Most experts believe that sexual orientation involves a combination of physical, environmental and social factors, although many studies focus on physiological research. Since the 1970s, homosexuality has ceased to be regarded as a disease by psychologists and psychiatrists.

p28.original: 情绪是如何激励我们的

p30.original: 情绪是一种特殊的动机，能帮助我们关注和应对重要（通常是外部）的情况，并与他人交流我们的意图。
p30.en: Emotion is a particular motivation that helps us to focus on and respond to important (usually external) situations and to share our intentions with others.

p31.original: 情绪包含四个主要成分：生理唤醒、认知解释、主观感受和行为表现。达马西奥说，主观的体验源于躯体标记，包括身体对情绪环境反应的记忆。
p31.en: Emotions consist of four main components: physical awakening, cognitive interpretation, subjective perception and behaviour. According to Damacio, subjective experiences stem from body markings, including the memory of body reactions to emotional environments.

p32.original: 情绪也可以作为动机。从进化的角度来看，它们帮助我们接近或避免对生存和繁殖至关重要的重复刺激。在社交方面，情绪表达是用来交流体验和意图的，这显然是“镜像神经元”在起作用。
p32.en: Emotion can also be a motive. From an evolutionary point of view, they help us to approach or avoid the repetition of incentives that are essential for survival and reproduction. At the social level, emotional expression is used to communicate experiences and intentions, which are clearly the work of mirror neurons.

p33.original: 大多数专家认为，数量有限的基本情绪综合起来，会产生大量的次级情绪。至少有七种基本的面部表情具有跨文化一致性，但是它们可以被特定文化的表达规则所改变。这些普遍的情绪很可能是基于生理产生的。
p33.en: Most experts felt that a limited number of underlying emotions combined would produce a large number of secondary emotions. At least seven basic facial expressions have cross-cultural consistency, but they can be altered by the rules of expression of a particular culture. These general emotions are likely to be biologically based.

p34.original: 男性和女性之间的一些情绪差异有生理根源。这体现在某些情绪障碍的发病率不同，也体现在男性更频繁地发怒上。此外，文化差异表明，情绪上的一些性别差异是习得的。具体来说，不同的文化引导男人和女人采用不同的表达规则来控制情绪表达。尽管有差异，但不能简单地说哪一种性别更情绪化。
p34.en: Some emotional differences between men and women have biological roots. This is reflected in the different incidence of certain emotional disorders and in the more frequent anger among men. In addition, cultural differences indicate that some emotional gender differences are learned. Specifically, different cultures lead men and women to adopt different expressions to control emotional expression. Despite differences, it is not possible to simply say which sex is more emotional.

p35.original: 什么过程控制了我们的情绪

p37.original: 大脑中有两种情绪处理系统：一种是有意识的，另一种是无意识的。这个发现为一些关于情绪与认知的早期争论提供了新的思路。
p37.en: There are two emotional systems in the brain: conscious and unconscious. This discovery has provided new ideas for some early debates about emotions and perceptions.

p38.original: 神经科学揭示了大脑中两种截然不同的情绪系统。一个是快速反应系统，主要在无意识的水平上运作，依赖于深层边缘结构，尤其是杏仁核。另一个是慢速反应系统，涉及大脑皮层的意识处理。这些通路在腹内侧前额皮层相交。情绪还包括由自主神经系统和激素系统传递的信息引起的内脏反应。除这两种情绪系统外，两个大脑半球都有偏侧化效应，每个脑半球都专门处理不同类别的情绪。
p38.en: Neural science reveals two distinct emotional systems in the brain. One is the rapid response system, which operates mainly at an unconscious level and relies on deep peripheral structures, particularly almond cores. The other is a slow-response system, which involves conscious treatment of the cortex of the brain. These routes intersect with the front cortex on the inside of the stomach. Emotions also include internal and obstetric reactions caused by messages transmitted from autonomous nervous and hormone systems. In addition to these two emotional systems, both hemispheres have side-effects, each of which specializes in different types of emotions.

p39.original: 倒U形曲线描述了情绪唤醒和成绩之间的复杂关系：不断增加的唤醒水平会提高成绩（但只会提高到某一最佳唤醒水平），这取决于任务的复杂性。刺激寻求者似乎对唤醒有特别高的需要。
p39.en: The inverted U curve describes the complex relationship between emotional awakening and achievement: an increasing level of awakening increases performance (but only to an optimal level of awakening), depending on the complexity of the task. Stimulators seem to have a particularly high need for awakening.

p40.original: 理解这两种情绪系统可以帮助解决一些长期存在的争论，包括认知和身体反应在情绪中的作用。詹姆斯-兰格理论认为，身体的感觉和身体的反应产生情绪感受。与之相反的坎农-巴德理论强调，认知评价会产生情绪和伴随的身体反应。斯坦利·沙赫特的双因素理论认为，情绪是对内部身体状态和外部环境认知评价的结果。研究表明，这三种观点都有一定的道理。
p40.en: Understanding these two emotional systems can help to resolve some of the long-standing disputes, including the role of cognitive and physical responses in emotions. The James-Langer theory suggests that the body's feelings and physical reactions give rise to emotional feelings. In contrast, the Canon-Bad theory emphasizes that cognitive evaluation produces emotional and accompanying physical reactions. Stanley Schacht's dual-factor theory is that emotion is the result of an assessment of internal physical state and the perception of the external environment. Studies have shown that there is some merit in all three.

p41.original: 每个人都有自己独特的情绪风格，涉及六个基本维度，包括一个人控制情绪表达的能力。情商是一种防止情绪失控的能力，其对维持良好的社会关系来说至关重要。它与传统智商测试所衡量的能力截然不同。情绪控制可以习得，这在情绪管理项目中得到了证明。情商测试结果显示，得分高的人更容易在社交场合中获得成功。
p41.en: Everyone has his or her own unique emotional style, which involves six basic dimensions, including the ability of a person to control emotional expression. Intelligence is a capacity to prevent emotions from spiralling out of control and is essential to maintaining good social relations. It is distinct from the capabilities measured by traditional IQ tests. Emotional control is available, as evidenced in the Emotional Management Project. The results of intelligence tests show that high-scoring people are more likely to succeed in social settings.

p42.original: 批判性思维的应用：测谎仪真的能测出谎言吗
p42.en: Application of critical thinking: Can a lie detector really detect a lie?

p43.original: “测谎仪”的工作原理是假定人们在说谎时会唤醒相关的生理线索。测谎仪的使用者能让嫌犯相信测谎仪可以显示他们何时说谎，因此达到使其招供的目的，但并没有证据表明测谎的结果的可靠性有多高。尤其令人困惑的是，在某些情况下，测谎仪会甄别出比实际说谎者更多的假阳性结果。使用面部表情或大脑扫描的替代方法正在探索中，但到目前为止还没有被证实是有效的。
p43.en: The “false detector” works on the assumption that people are able to awaken the physical clues when they lie. The users of the lie detector have been able to convince suspects that the lie detector shows when they are lying and thus serves the purpose of obtaining their confession, but there is no evidence of how reliable the results of the lie detector is. It is particularly confusing that in some cases the polygraph detects more false positive results than the actual liar. Alternative methods for using facial expressions or brain scans are being explored, but have not been proven to be effective so far.

p44.original: [1]注：这与《圣经》中所罗门王的假设正好相反，他不得不解决两个女人之间的监护权纠纷，这两个女人都声称是同一个孩子的监护人。据说，所罗门王下令将婴儿切成两半，分给每个妇女一半。通过观察她们的不同反应，他断定变得情绪激动的那个女人说的是真话。
p44.en: Note: Contrary to King Roman's assumption in the Bible, he had to resolve a custody dispute between two women who claimed to be guardians of the same child. The King of Solomon is said to have ordered the baby to be cut in half, to be divided among every woman. By observing their different reactions, he concluded that the woman who became emotional was telling the truth.
